decisions.reason: The primary source (Murre & Dros, 2015, 10.1371/journal.pone.0120644; no prior adjudication or state file exists) explicitly establishes that Ebbinghaus (1880) [8] (the Habilitation Urmanuskript, shipped as input_row_index 402 and coded as target_index 0) and Ebbinghaus (1885) [9] (Über das Gedächtnis, coded as target_index 1) are two reports of the same classic single-subject experiment on the forgetting curve conducted in 1879-1880 (lines 52-58, 68-75, 102-112). In Method (lines 199-203), the authors confirm that 'The learning and relearning times given in his 1885/1913 volume [ 20 ] are the same as in 1880 [ 8 ], but to each interval he has now added 88 s for reasons that are not made clear', and that Ebbinghaus fitted a power function in 1880 and a logarithmic function in 1885 to the same experimental dataset (lines 52-53, 757-760). Because Ebbinghaus (1885) (target_index 1) is a subsequent report of the exact same original experiment and empirical finding already represented by shipped input_row_index 402 (Ebbinghaus, 1880, target_index 0), it is covered by report equivalence and is not an omitted row.
